findings.evidence: template/scripts/agent_friction.py (~line 1406-1411 post-change): `try: main = read_platform_config(root)["main_branch"] except Exception: main = "main"`. The spec says platform scripts SHALL NOT supply per-call-site defaults for required keys. A missing or invalid .dev-platform.toml is silently replaced by built-in 'main' instead of failing with the file/key diagnostic.
findings.summary: agent_friction.changed_paths still substitutes a per-call-site default 'main' for the required main_branch key. It swallows any config error to do so.

findings.evidence: template/scripts/capability_manager.py:208-212 uses `_load_toml(root / ".dev-platform.toml")` and then `config["agent_tools"]`. The spec requires configuration to be validated once at read time against the schema. Here a missing key raises a bare KeyError with no file/key/line-to-add diagnostic, and an absent file is not reported through the schema path.
findings.summary: capability_manager.configured_providers reads agent_tools straight from the raw TOML. This bypasses the single read-time schema validation.
